title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：tower　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tower 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the planner ① climbed the tower that no citizen in the district would have described, and he said the climbing was the whole of the year. The ② tower, meaning the spire itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a tower, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tower in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ tower at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tower, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the planner said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tower was the whole of the matter, meaning the watch and not the spire. The ⑥ tower, meaning the watch and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tower, he said, is either something you climb or the only word that means both a spire and a watch. He said the watch is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ tower had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ tower of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of describing; tower, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tower I remember is the spire described in the report, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ tower, my mother said in 1986, is the only spire that improves by being described; every tower, she said, is a watch that has agreed to look like a spire. She said the watch was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 塔；塔楼（指街区里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 塔；塔楼（指那座塔本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：climb the tower 登这一座塔
D. n. 塔；塔楼（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 塔之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的塔之事）
F. n. 塔；塔楼（指规划报告里写到、被描述的那一座）
G. n. 塔、瞭望（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 瞭望（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: climbed the tower that no citizen in the district would have described
The tower, meaning the spire itself and not the plan
the tower at the far square
the tower was the whole of the matter
the tower had become a line in a report
The tower of the whole thing
A tower, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: climb the tower 意为“登这一座塔”，1977 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯描述的一座塔做了一遍。
tower 意为“塔；塔楼”，指那座塔本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被描述。
tower 意为“塔；塔楼”，指街区里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
tower 意为“塔；塔楼”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tower 意为“塔、瞭望”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座瞭望就是那件事的全部。
tower 意为“瞭望”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座塔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tower 意为“塔；塔楼”，指规划报告里写到、被描述的那一座，到 1982 年这一座成了规划报告里的一行。
tower 意为“塔之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的塔之事是一处街区和三个年份的描述。
tower 意为“塔；塔楼”，我记得的是规划报告里描述过的那一座，1984 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一座。
tower 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，塔是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的塔。
